title: "Srestha Datta"

I build analytics workflows that turn raw, complex data into decisions 
businesses can actually act on.

I'm completing my MS in Business Analytics at UC Irvine's Paul Merage 
School of Business, adding to an MBA from NMIMS and a Computer Science 
engineering degree. The combination means I can move fluidly between 
technical teams, marketing functions, and executive stakeholders.

My recent work spans revenue impact modeling for a real skincare brand 
client, Airbnb pricing analytics across 13,500+ listings, retail 
customer segmentation for ZARA, and geospatial water quality prediction 
for EY's 2026 global AI challenge.

I'm particularly drawn to CPG, beauty, retail, and digital marketing 
analytics — spaces where consumer behavior, brand strategy, and data 
intersect in ways that are both analytically rich and genuinely fun to 
work on.
